rationale.consistency: Follows Caddy conventions, naming, and module registration perfectly.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles rate floors and chunking well, but global deadlines silently overwrite per-route deadlines due to wrapper nesting.
rationale.scope: Implements all requested features, but violates the 'no behavior change' constraint by enabling global timeouts by default.
rationale.readability: Clean structure, descriptive names, and excellent comments explaining the subtle deadline logic.
rationale.robustness: Safe against panics and handles unsupported writers gracefully, but nested wrappers clobber the same connection state.
rationale.maintainability: Well encapsulated logic, but the structural design makes composing multiple deadline layers inherently conflict.
